title: Cinema Schema with Enforced Constraints
instructions: Implement `connect`, `create_schema`, `add_show_inventory`, `shows_in_region` and `seat_counts` in `cinema_schema.py` using the standard-library `sqlite3`. Push every rule you can into the database: foreign keys, composite unique constraints and a status `CHECK`. Inventory creation must be one idempotent SQL statement.

evidence.label: Rejects a theatre that points at a non-existent region (foreign keys on)
Rejects a duplicate seat label on one screen but allows it on another
Rejects a show-seat status outside AVAILABLE / BLOCKED / BOOKED
Rejects a second show_seats row for the same (show, seat)
Lists a region's shows by start time, and returns [] for an unknown region
Creates inventory per screen and returns 0 on a repeat call
Counts show seats per status, only for statuses that occur
connect() uses sqlite3.Row and turns PRAGMA foreign_keys on
Enforces unique region names and seat type names
